family.description: The iron guanylylpyridinol (FeGP) cofactor biosynthesis enzymes are encoded in a cluster of at least seven conserved genes (hcgA-G). This family represents the (SAM)-dependent methyltransferase HgcC [[cite:PUB00098593],[cite:PUB00098592]], which covalently attaches the methyl group at the 3-position of the pyridinol ring. It is predominantly found as a monomer in solution, composed of a Rossmann-like coenzyme-binding-domain consisting of six parallel and one peripheral antiparallel strand flanked by six alpha-helices and a smaller alpha/beta domain [[cite:PUB00098593]].
family.name: FeGP cofactor biosynthesis protein, methyltransferase HcgC
